description: Red Canary Atomic Red Team scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Impact (TA0040). 66 atomics covering 8 techniques: T1485, T1486, T1489, T1490, T1491.001, T1496, T1529, T1531. Converted from Red Canary atomic-red-team YAML. Tag keys prefixed with 'art_'.
author: Red Canary (converted by X3M.AI)
prerequisites: Morgana agent installed on target machine
PyYAML not required at runtime — scripts are pre-converted
capabilities: Provides 66 focused Red Canary Atomic Red Team tests covering 8 MITRE ATT&CK techniques for Impact.
Exercises high-consequence behaviors that can disrupt availability or integrity using small, independently selectable atomic tests.
Includes one-step Chains for individual atomics and a full-tactic convenience Chain when multiple tests are available.
use_cases: Validate endpoint, identity, network, and SIEM detections mapped to ATT&CK Impact.
Verify that preventive controls block expected behavior and that telemetry reaches defensive tooling.
Select individual atomics to close specific ATT&CK coverage gaps during an authorized Purple Team exercise.
safety_notes: Operational impact varies by atomic test; inspect each command, input, prerequisite, and cleanup action before execution.
Full-tactic convenience Chains run many independent tests sequentially and are not a validated adversary campaign.
Run only on explicitly authorized targets and verify cleanup results after each test.

scripts.id: ART - T1491.001 - Configure LegalNoticeCaption and LegalNoticeText registry...
scripts.name: ART - T1491.001 - Configure LegalNoticeCaption and LegalNoticeText registry...
scripts.description:
Display ransom message to users at system start-up by configuring registry keys HKLM\SOFTWARE\Micosoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\LegalNoticeCaption and HKLM\SOFTWARE\Micosoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\LegalNoticeText.

[SynAck Ransomware](https://www.trendmicro.com/vinfo...
scripts.command:
$orgLegalNoticeCaption = (Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System -Name LegalNoticeCaption).LegalNoticeCaption
$orgLegalNoticeText = (Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System -Name LegalNoticeText).LegalNoticeText
$newLegalNoticeCaption = "#{art_impact_1491_001_legal_notice_caption}"
$newLegalNoticeText = "#{art_impact_1491_001_legal_notice_text}"
Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System -Name LegalNoticeCaption -Value $newLegalNoticeCaption -Type String -Force
Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System -Name LegalNoticeText -Value $newLegalNoticeText -Type String -Force
scripts.cleanup_command:
Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System -Name LegalNoticeCaption -Value $orgLegalNoticeCaption -Type String -Force
Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System -Name LegalNoticeText -Value $orgLegalNoticeText -Type String -Force
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1491.001 - Windows - Display a simulated ransom note via Notepad (no...
scripts.name: ART - T1491.001 - Windows - Display a simulated ransom note via Notepad (no...
scripts.description:
Creates a temporary ransom-note text file and opens it in Notepad to
simulate ransomware "note display" behavior without making destructive
changes. SAFE and non-destructive.
scripts.technique_name: Windows - Display a simulated ransom note via Notepad (no...
scripts.command:
$notePath = Join-Path $env:TEMP "#{art_impact_1491_001_note_filename}"
$pidPath  = Join-Path $env:TEMP "#{art_impact_1491_001_pid_filename}"

$Title = "#{art_impact_1491_001_note_title}"
$Body  = "#{art_impact_1491_001_note_body}"

$header  = $Title + "`r`n" + ('=' * $Title.Length) + "`r`n`r`n"
$content = $header + $Body

[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($notePath, $content, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)

$p = Start-Process notepad.exe -ArgumentList "`"$notePath`"" -PassThru
$p.Id | Out-File -FilePath $pidPath -Encoding ascii -Force
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance
